applicable_eu_rules.requirement: Use the format established by Regulation (EC) No 1030/2002 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2017/1954 and implemented by Commission Implementing Decision C(2018) 7767 as amended by C(2021) 3726.

Residence cards must bear the title Residence card or Permanent residence card and use the standard code Family Member EU Art 10 DIR 2004/38/EC or Family Member EU Art 20 DIR 2004/38/EC in data field [10].

Nonconforming existing cards generally cease to be valid at expiry or by 3 August 2026; cards lacking minimum ICAO security standards or a functional ICAO-compliant MRZ are invalid; qualifying cards that meet minimum security and specified Annex points have the longer transition to expiry or 3 August 2031.

comparison.document_titles: Visually present in both languages and consistent with the Article 7(2) title requirement.
comparison.overall: The official Austrian specimens are accurately captured and accepted as statutory sources. They do not demonstrate all technical or encoded-data requirements for current issued cards. Do not infer card compliance from the annex illustration; verify the live issued-card specification or current implementation before applying it.
